name: 3000 Cycles with You
source:
Life aboard Concordia Station is meant to be peaceful. For Leutnant Arany Vencel, it’s anything but. Death keeps visiting his dreams… but is it coming for him next?

[From [url=https://ratgirlexe.itch.io/3000-cycles-with-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
康科迪亚车站上的生活本来就是平静的。对于阿兰尼·文塞尔中尉来说，这绝对不是。死亡不断造访他的梦境……但下一个会降临到他身上吗？

[来自[url=https://ratgirlexe.itch.io/3000-cycles-with-you]Itch.io[/url]]
